requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Concern-mixing detected. Decomposed into one functional requirement (inform security service) and one quality requirement (2s response time constraint) per Pohl §25.2.

source_fragments: The system shall inform the security service
structured_requirements.final_statement: When damage is detected, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action. The condition is derived from the context of the quality criterion.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service within 2 seconds of detecting damage.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (response time) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume the specific mechanism of 'damage detection' or the exact nature of the 'security service' beyond what was stated.
